preferred_referent: Continuity Portal → Human Areas over Connected Sources
goal: Expose the repo through ordinary human areas while preserving the social portal as the shared entrance. Education, production, research, social interaction, personal organization, money, creativity, world/place context, library, and tool-building remain peer entrances; connected source systems keep their own local state underneath.
next_movement: Exercise the human-area catalog against real and simulated movement. Add concrete tools and entrances inside each area only when reached by evidence, while allowing tools and work to cross areas without duplicating source state.
walls: Do not redefine A/B as the portal, an area, a source system, School, Words, or the runtime.
Do not make repository folders the site's top-level human categories.
Do not make education, production, research, social interaction, or any other one area the site focus.
Do not turn human-facing areas into sealed disciplines; cross-area movement remains valid.
Do not flatten source-system state into the area catalog.
Do not require users to understand A/B, runtime, handoffs, provenance, protocols, or repo taxonomy to use the site.
Do not treat simulated movement as real human evidence.
Do not turn countries into a separate architecture; countries are WORLD/place anchors.
Do not let note creation automatically create a task or handoff.
Do not let an activation mutate state merely by being requested.
Do not accept COMPLETE without the handoff's required admissible evidence.
Do not expose private live Personal Operations state through repository commits.

handoff.from: Portal-first social hub → Human area fill
handoff.reason: The portal already provided the social shared entrance, but its visible sections were still organized around source systems such as School, Calendar, Research, Jobs, and Factory. The current movement collapses repo outputs into ordinary human areas while retaining those systems underneath as sources.

human_areas.rule: Areas are peer entrances into connected repo capability, not sealed backend categories. Every area may expose existing tools and support building reusable tools from the layers underneath.

verified_run.benchmark: Human Area Fill over Portal Hub
checks: The portal remains the social shared entrance.
Human areas are represented in runtime/http/site_catalog.json.
Every area exposes fields/entrances and tool-building examples.
School, Calendar, Personal Operations, Research, Jobs, and Factory remain connected sources underneath.
Existing live runtime forms, attention projection, feed, handoffs, and source boundaries remain present.
